name: OPSD-BE
notes: ENTSO-E BE system load (OPSD time_series 60min, BE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency) + ERA5 weather (Open-Meteo). aux column holds the TSO's own published day-ahead load forecast (BE_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency, coverage 100.0%). exogenous-series rules: (1) a solar/wind series is dropped if its raw data has any single internal gap longer than 720 h (30 d); (2) then dropped if <50% present over the load span (v1). generation columns kept: {'solar': 'BE_solar_generation_actual (max internal gap 0 h)', 'wind': 'BE_wind_onshore_generation_actual (max internal gap 0 h)'}. dropped: [none]. span start trimmed from 2015-01-01 00:00:00 (first load row) to 2015-01-01 08:00:00 (first fully observed row). missing cells interpolated: 8 (per channel {'solar': 7, 'wind': 1}; linear up to 6 h, then ffill/bfill).
